plugins.name: Schema Diff
plugins.description: Compare the schema of your open database against another connection and database, then generate a dialect-correct ALTER migration script that opens in a new query tab. Read-only — it never runs DDL itself. Built-in tool plugin.
plugins.author: Lionear

versions.notes: First release: compare two databases and generate an ALTER migration script.

Secondary indexes and SQLite support, plus fixes found by round-trip verification against live engines: auto-numbering survives a table recreate, engine-named constraints no longer diff as drop-and-recreate, and varchar(max) is no longer read as varchar(1).
Rebuilt for DataTray. The app and its plugin assemblies were renamed in 0.6.0, so every earlier version of this plugin fails to load on a current build — install this one.

plugins.name: Copy Table
plugins.description: Copy a table to another connection and database: structure + data, structure only or data only, all rows or the first N, optionally keeping identity/sequence values and bringing the table's indexes and foreign keys along. Run the copy with a live checklist, or open it as a script on the target to review the SQL first. Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server and SQLite, with source and target on the same engine.
plugins.author: Lionear

versions.notes: First release: copy a table to another connection and database, run or as a script, with indexes and foreign keys optional.
Rebuilt for DataTray. The app and its plugin assemblies were renamed in 0.6.0, so every earlier version of this plugin fails to load on a current build — install this one.

plugins.name: ClickHouse
plugins.description: Connect to ClickHouse over its HTTP interface and browse databases, tables, views, columns and data-skipping indexes with on-disk sizes and row counts. Run queries and multi-statement scripts (sent one request each, since the server rejects a batched body), EXPLAIN, SHOW CREATE definitions, DDL Create for databases and tables (ENGINE = MergeTree with an ORDER BY), the Activity Monitor over system.processes with KILL QUERY, and user/role management. Result grids are read-only: the protocol carries no primary-key metadata, and ClickHouse mutates rows through asynchronous ALTER TABLE UPDATE.
plugins.author: Lionear

versions.notes: First release: ClickHouse as a provider plugin, with a container recipe for spinning up a local server.

plugins.name: DuckDB
plugins.description: Open a DuckDB file — or an in-memory scratchpad — and browse schemas, tables, views, sequences, columns and indexes with row and column counts. Query files directly the way DuckDB is meant to be used: SELECT * FROM 'events.parquet', read_csv_auto('data.csv'), read_json_auto(...), with no database file needed at all. Scripts, EXPLAIN, View Definition and DDL Create for schemas and tables included. A plain table browse stays editable when the table has a primary key; a join, aggregate, view or file comes back read-only. Bundles the DuckDB engine, so the download is large.
plugins.author: Lionear

versions.notes: First release: DuckDB as a provider plugin, including querying Parquet/CSV/JSON files directly. Ships the DuckDB engine for every platform DataTray runs on, hence the 82 MB download.
